summary: Team messaging platform with channels, DMs, files and workflow automation.
access_note: Create a Slack app in a free workspace and install it via OAuth; bot tokens (xoxb-) and user tokens (xoxp-) are issued.
blocker_note: Slack's MCP server only accepts directory-published (Marketplace) or internal apps; broader multi-tenant use of the Web API outside the Marketplace is subject to Slack's app distribution rules.

evidence.quote: Slack apps are installed with a v2 OAuth 2.0 flow.
The `oauth.v2.access` API method supports generating either a bot token or user token or both.
The Web API is a collection of HTTP RPC-style methods, all with URLs in the form https://slack.com/api/METHOD_FAMILY.method.
Only directory-published apps or internal apps may use MCP.

notes: Slack states the Web API is not REST. Marketplace/rate-limit page (docs.slack.dev/distribution/distributing-apps-with-oauth) returned 404, so the app_review blocker rests on the MCP page and general knowledge; some quotes come from fetch-tool excerpts.
